items.title: Regulation of Blood Flow in Capillaries (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Regulation of Blood Flow in Capillaries: a main subheading of 11.2 Blood vessels, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 244-244.

blocks.text: Capillaries mein kitna khoon jaye, yeh capillaries ko tang (constrict) ya chaura (dilate) kar ke control hota hai. Nerves ka signal (nervous stimulation) capillaries ko tang kar sakta hai, aur kuch chemicals, maslan histamine, unhen chaura kar sakte hain. Kuch capillaries doosri capillaries ke loops (chhallon) ke zariye arterioles aur venules se juri hoti hain. Har loop ke shuru mein muscle ka ek chhalla hota hai jise pre-capillary sphincter kehte hain. Yeh sphincters control karte hain ke capillaries mein kitna khoon jaye.

blocks.alt: Oopar arteriole aur neeche venule, chhe capillary loops se jure jo arteriole ke qareeb surkh aur venule ke qareeb neele hain. Har loop ke arteriole se nikalne ki jagah challa (ring) numa pre-capillary sphincter hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sphincter sukre to us loop mein khoon kam jata hai, dheela ho to zyada. Is tarah jism zaroorat ke mutabiq khoon bheejta hai.
